name: Phi-1

lifecycle.note: Weights are still downloadable from Microsoft's Hugging Face organisation (checked 2026-10-01).

dates.note: Announced with the arXiv paper of 2023-06-20. The weights were published later on Hugging Face (microsoft/phi-1), but no Microsoft page states the day or month.

summary.text: Phi-1 is a 1.3 billion parameter Transformer language model from Microsoft, specialised for basic Python coding and introduced in the paper Textbooks Are All You Need in June 2023. It was trained on textbook-quality web data plus synthetic textbooks and exercises generated with GPT-3.5, and its weights are published on Hugging Face under the MIT License.

notes: The paper writes the name in lowercase (phi-1); the Hugging Face card uses Phi-1. The Hugging Face repository was created on 2023-09-10 according to the Hugging Face API, which is not a stated release date, so dates.released is left empty. The card now states the MIT license; the repository commit history shows a Research License file was deleted on 2024-01-09. Training data included synthetic textbooks generated with OpenAI gpt-3.5-turbo-0301 (training data, not a model relation). The paper reports benchmark results.
